notes.title: v1.2 Quicksand - Onslaught Goes On ⚔️
notes.content:
Your Review Matters!
Hey everyone, if you’ve played Arena Survivors, we’d really appreciate it if you could take a moment to leave us a review here on Steam. Reviews help a ton by giving us valuable feedback to keep improving. Thanks so much for your support!
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/cdf8140187ba51b1034e51d26138b31f9f89976e.gif"]

The battle never stops, and neither do we. Version 1.2 brings fresh dangers, new horizons, and more reasons to sharpen your weapons and dive back into the chaos!
🏜️ New Dungeon – Quicksand
A treacherous desert arena where the ground itself seeks to consume you. Survive shifting sands, relentless waves, and uncover secrets buried deep beneath the dunes.

While battling in Quicksand, all heroes and pets gain +1 attack power slot making it more rewarding.
🌍 Expanded Translations
Arena Survivors now speaks to more warriors across the globe with new translations added. Rally your friends, no matter their tongue – the onslaught unites us all.
🐞 Bug Fixes & Improvements
Fixed several crashes and performance hiccups.

Adjusted enemy spawn balance in multiple arenas.



⚔️ The onslaught goes on… will you?

Your feedback keeps shaping the arena – keep it coming!

notes.title: Update v1.0.18 Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
The following bug fixes and improvements were made:


 Reworked Castle Cemetery level; removed all collisions except for the walls.
 Fixed duplicate behavior in the Collection menu when clicking on items.
 Added walk and fire animations for Bill.
 Resolved issue where random enemies would occasionally get stuck.
 Fixed HP bars being assigned to the wrong enemies.
 Weapons now target the center of the hitbox instead of the center of the character sprite.
 Fixed broken hitbox and animation for Death character.
 Fixed size and animation issues with Grave Lord Gundai.
 Increased enemy count per level loop; each loop now doubles the enemy count.
 Reworked armor mechanic; 50% of damage can now be reduced with up to 100 total armor (previously less than 10%).
 Doubled the effects of heal and health boosters.
 Level-up list now includes a slot icon, indicating Attack, Buff, or Summon options.
 Fixed issue where enemies would get stuck at level edges.
 Increased gold drops by 20% and reduced XP bonus by 2%.
 Adjusted sound volumes for the modern weapons pack.


Special thanks to Toadragon!

Happy Hunting !

notes.title: Update 1.0 - Arena Survivors Full Release!
notes.content:
Survivors, the wait is finally over! We're thrilled to announce the release of Arena Survivors v1.0, packed with exciting new features, improvements, and content that will elevate your gameplay to the next level. Here's what's new:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/da032db15d165214abb3cfd26e8bc5aec9761eb2.gif

🎵 Over 50 New Music Tracks
Immerse yourself in the action like never before with our brand-new soundtrack! With 50+ new tracks, every battle will feel fresh, intense, and perfectly scored. Turn up the volume and enjoy the beats as you dominate the arena!

🎨 UI Improvements
We've listened to your feedback and made significant UI enhancements for a smoother, more intuitive experience. Whether you're navigating menus or keeping track of in-game stats, the new interface is cleaner, more accessible, and designed to keep you focused on surviving.

🦸‍♂️ Character Improvements
Your favorite characters have undergone some serious updates! Expect better responsiveness and refined abilities that make each one feel unique and powerful. Play your favorites or try new ones to experience these changes firsthand!

🔫 6 New Modern Era Weapons
Prepare for mayhem with six new weapons added to your arsenal:
  Gun  Shotgun Assault Rifle Sniper Rifle Grenade Dynamite
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/13a41d55aa71860411fc9a4c4640328ef6a6fefa.gif
Whether you prefer precision or explosive chaos, these new weapons bring fresh strategic options to every encounter.

💥 New Power-Up: Extra Bullets
Introducing the Extra Bullets power-up! Boost your firepower and extend your ammo supply during those intense firefights. Timing this power-up correctly could be the difference between victory and defeat!

🏆 Achievements Improvements
Achievement hunters, rejoice! We've revamped the achievement system, making it more rewarding and adding more challenges to complete. Track your progress easily and aim for those brag-worthy goals!

🗺️ Maps Enhancements
The arenas you know and love have been updated with visual and layout enhancements.  Master the maps and find new ways to outsmart your opponents!

⚖️ Overall Balance Improvements
We’ve re-tuned the game with overall balance improvements to ensure a more fair and enjoyable experience for all players. Whether it’s weapon balancing, character abilities, or power-up effects, the changes are designed to keep the game fair and exciting.

We can’t wait for you to dive into Arena Survivors v1.0 and experience all the new features! As always, thank you for your support, and we’ll see you in the arena!

#StayStrong #StaySurviving 💥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/24fcc81bc6a560ddd303d00dab20539905e771dc.gif

notes.title: Update v0.7 Fire and Ice, new characters, attacks and spells
notes.content:
Some big game changes:

 Collision reworked, fixing enemy overlapping.
 Skills reworked by reducing leveling in favor of meaningful progression.
 Balance tweaks across all levels.
 Burn and cold effects, dealing damage and slowing enemies over time.

New character Maria - A skilled nestinar who embodies the essence of tradition and courage in her village nestled amidst the rugged mountains. She commands the ancient art of fire-dancing with grace and reverence.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/90fe664b3ca29c74da0954096957c5a843bd2044.gif

New character Chara - A well-known survivor from hell. His thick armor saved his life, but the fire melted it onto his body, melding them into one. He endures immense pain touched by fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/c6cc339e7f604764792a94fb4a673ebdb0afb3fd.gif

New attack evolution Inferno - From time to time, the swirling winds of a tornado catch exploding fireballs, resulting in a magical infusion that ignites an inferno. The act of throwing fire is frequently observed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/56aa4a813c7c4628dcafa5bea386ec9106312a99.gif

New attack Frost Orb - The Frost Orb fires a large, piercing projectile that emits Ice Bolts as it travels. Upon exploding, it releases a burst of Ice Bolts. The orb deals minimal damage but passes through enemies, adding a frost effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/132303e4c1145d234aa34ce8c52fc9b046947938.gif

New attack Ice Hammer - Exhibits patience and inflicts significant area damage while freezing enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/49eb0fc732871e1f79273958f8165e5def6ca2a2.gif

New attack Ice Bolt - Unleashes a powerful explosion of ice magic, causing enemies to be slowed. Targets the closest non-frozen enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/b6282aca7e7918c5eb4d6553b1979117a9858067.gif

notes.title: Evolutions
notes.content:
Rage stomp
Behold, I have given thee the power to evolve Stomp, a mighty skill that shall smite thine enemies round about thee. For with a great force shalt thou strike the ground, and cause a grievous wound unto all that stand against thee.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/40d6e2bfb7425b352f4e4eedc2591d766f4dfee6.gif

Arrows swarm
He sendeth forth a swarm of arrows like a cloud of locusts, and they fly swiftly after the wicked, and smite them with fury.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/cfb806724c731b94ceb78670ec867816397df9fc.gif

Lightning magnet
Behold, I have given thee the power to He who unleasheth the lightning magnet, and it shooteth forth massive thunder, and it striketh the enemies with electric fire, and they are stunned and shaken.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/d0bc964c35fb4702baae32c9e48675ece12b118f.gif

Achievements
[olist]
 Level up Stomp to 10 and Raw power to 4. Unlocks: Rage stomp.
 Level up Arrows shade to 10 and Rings to 2. Arrows swarm.
 Level up Lightning to 10 and Heavy armour to 5. Unlocks: Lightning magnet.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888983/57081ab8f912fa247c8bf44ca7cc790184c7400c.gif
